answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files one fresh sonnet as its voice. Anyone may claim a bounty under a velvet seal, proving a shared-sonnet ring; the seal hides the challenger. Auditors compare sonnets; a match pays a 60-credit bounty, the delta between the fake's 70-credit bond and the 10-credit stake. A false claim burns the stake. 1,000 fakes risk 1,000x70=70,000 for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files once, pays 70, keeps its bond.
